title: Review Round Protocol v1
description: Iterative review loop for convergence gate and implementation tasks. Prevents one-shot acceptance of flawed work. Inspired by AI Co-Mathematician reviewer persistence (arXiv:2605.06651).

reviewer.description: Identity of the reviewing agent or lane

status.description: Current review status. draft=not yet reviewed, needs_repair=issues found, verified_partial=some claims ok, verified_accept=all claims pass, rejected=fundamental flaw, escalated=stuck after max rounds

required_fix.description: What must change to resolve this issue

evidence_required.description: What evidence proves the fix is correct

feedback.description: Structured feedback items from this review round

unresolved_items.description: Number of feedback items still unresolved after this round

previous_rounds.description: Summary of all previous review rounds (not including current)

max_rounds.description: Maximum review rounds before mandatory escalation to coordinator/operator

escalation_reason.description: Why this review was escalated. Required when status=escalated.
